messages:
mica-recruiter: Candidate (L. Park) just DM'd — their child's school had an emergency closure this morning and they can't get childcare until 2pm. They asked if we can: 1) shift their interview to start at 2:30pm, 2) confirm we offer same-day childcare stipend, and 3) reserve a private quiet room in case they need to pump/feed while onsite. Also asked if they can do a hybrid: first two screens remote and final on-site.

jo-peopleops: We can accommodate. Childcare stipend policy: up to $120 same-day for childcare; candidate submits receipts to people-ops@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Childcare - Park" and we'll fast-track. I'll reserve a quiet room and add a low-fragrance catering flag. @taylor-it can you prep a loaner in case they need to come later?

taylor-it: Will hold LOANER-9901 (MacBook) at reception with a headset and USB-C adapter. Label: PARK-9901. Sanitized and ready by 2:00pm. If they need to join remote, I'll also confirm CodePair access for the panel.

omar-hiringmgr: Panel can start at 2:30pm. I'm fine with hybrid — remote for first two, in-person for the last. @rachel-panel can you host the remote coding session and ensure the candidate has editor access?

rachel-panel: Yes I can host CodePair and will set a temporary guest link. If they join in-person later we can do the pairing on my laptop. Also okay to extend end time by 20 minutes if needed.

facilities-bot: Quiet Room Q4 reserved 14:00-17:00. Low-fragrance lunch flagged. Reception instructed to hold PARK-9901 from 14:00. Parking voucher available up to $35.

security-bot: Temp guest badge issued; pickup code emailed to candidate. If they arrive after 5pm, ping security and we'll extend access.

recruiting-bot: ATS note: add "childcare-stipend" tag to candidate, record LOANER-9901 hold, and mark interview schedule changed to 14:30 start.

jo-peopleops: Logistics recap: 1) Childcare stipend approved up to $120, submit receipts 2) Quiet Room Q4 held 3) LOANER-9901 ready at reception 4) Hybrid schedule confirmed (remote AM -> in-person PM) 5) Low-fragrance lunch ordered.

mica-recruiter: I'll DM candidate now with Zoom link, guest CodePair link, badge pickup instructions, and stipend instructions. Candidate asked whether we can pre-pay a short rideshare if they need it; is same-day rideshare company-paid an option?

j0-peopleops: (typo fix) jo-peopleops: We can approve company rideshare up to $50 same-day for urgent caregiving pickups. Candidate should book and send receipt.

omar-hiringmgr: Thanks all. Please post a short status update after the candidate confirms.

mica-recruiter: Update — candidate confirmed hybrid plan and accepted remote check at 09:30. They'll aim to arrive by 14:10 to pick up LOANER-9901. I'll post again after the 09:30 test.
